description: Nessy (org.jwcarman.nessy) is an agent harness framework for Java 25: DirectHarness and QueuedHarness run agent turns with tools, inference providers such as Anthropic, durable or in-memory backends, memory, planning, approvals, MCP tools and Spring Boot support.
rules: Import org.jwcarman.nessy:nessy-bom and add the Nessy modules you need without versions; it does not manage org.jwcarman.codec:codec-jackson, which needs its own version.
DirectHarness.ask answers an AskOutcome (Answered, Refused, Failed, Busy, Terminated): branch on it rather than catching exceptions.
Build a harness once with its factory and keep it; use QueuedHarness.tell for work no caller waits on.
Check https://github.com/jwcarman/nessy/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md against the Nessy version in use: entries under Unreleased are not in any release yet.
